name: STILLFRAME: Neural Meditation & Cognitive Reset Centers
description: A meditation and cognitive wellness center chain operating across Tier 3-4, offering structured BCI-assisted neural quieting sessions that temporarily dampen feed connectivity, background augmentation processing, and ambient signal noise to produce states of genuine cognitive stillness that are increasingly rare in a city of persistent neural uplink. Sessions are supervised by licensed Cognitive Architects who monitor neural state via passive BCI read and intervene if the quieting produces distress. The flagship centers feature isolation chambers with acoustic and electromagnetic shielding.
story_hooks: A STILLFRAME client emerges from a deep isolation session to find that four hours have passed but their BCI has no gap in its recording — as if the session never happened despite their subjective experience.
A Cognitive Architect at a Tier 3 location has been quietly identifying clients whose neural quieting sessions reveal specific cognitive signatures, and someone is paying for that information.

The electromagnetic shielding in STILLFRAME's isolation chambers is blocking something other than ambient signal — and what it's blocking is only apparent to people who sit in the room for long enough.
